name: Jo
self_text: I am a Korean non-binary person in my mid 30s. When I am not out with my Canon, I love baking sourdough because I enjoy the patience it requires. I am looking for a structured instruction session at a moderate pace. I prefer to avoid gear debates and will not be taking portraits of each other. I am available Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or Sunday morning. It's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with not taking portraits of each other. It would be nice if you are okay with a moderate pace, and a small bonus if plenty of gear talk is fine or if gear talk is okay but not the point.
